<function name="FindByName" parent="ents" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Gets all entities with the given hammer targetname. This works internally by iterating over <page>ents.GetAll</page>.

Doesn't do anything on client.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">The targetname to look for.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table<Entity>">A table of all found entities.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
